title: Review, Integration & Extensive Reading Capstone
goal: Cumulative review of all 19 prefixes, 13 suffixes, 9 number roots, and 20 commonly-useful roots taught in this level; finish the Fry first-300 heart-word list (251–300); read a spiral-wrap knowledge text connecting all five topics; run an extensive-reading capstone activity; prepare for the Level 5 mastery check.
newToday: nothing new — this is consolidation. Tier-2 review: all 30 words taught this level (list below).
time: 45 min (longer than usual — this is a wrap-up session; split across two sittings if needed, doing §2–3 in one and §4–6 in another). **Materials:** paper, pencil, timer, and whatever graded reader/article the learner has been assigned or has chosen for the extensive-reading capstone (§4).
